frictions.description: Scoped snapshot (-s CSS selector) renumbers refs starting from @e1, which can conflict with full-page refs. Clicking a ref from a scoped snapshot when full-page elements have the same ref number causes ambiguity.
frictions.resolution: Used find text or getElementById for ambiguous buttons instead of refs
